author: Engineezy
description:
The world’s most over-engineered ruler.
•••
This uses a Peaucellier mechanism, which is an interesting because it converts rotary or curved motion into a true straight line using only rigid bars and pivots.  This absolutely destroys an actual ruler, which would have been way too reasonable.  I decided, because we were already being unreasonable, to add an adjustment dial encoder so you can change the length of the line. Hit the trigger and it draws a line.
•••
